title: Stocks Fall as AI Worries Trigger Treasury Gains
summary:
Renewed selling in chipmakers dragged down stocks as the dismal debut of a South Korean data center firm revived concerns about the artificial-intelligence trade.
John Mowrey, CIO at NFJ Investment Group, discusses the markets and AI trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Salesforce to Buy Marketing Platform Braze for $5.7 Billion
summary: Salesforce Inc. agreed to buy Braze Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered platform for marketers, for almost $5.7 billion in enterprise value.

title: CME's Terry Duffy on the Disconcerting State of Finance Regulation
summary: The CFTC was practically brand new when Terry Duffy started working at the CME almost five decades ago, and over the course of his career at the exchange, this legend of the trading world has seen an enormous amount of change when it comes to finance regulation, including the rise of prediction markets, 24/7 trading and perpetual futures. Duffy is set to transition out of his current position as CME CEO next year, and this conversation, recorded live at City Winery in Chicago, is a sort of exit interview. He tells us how regulation has evolved since the start of his time at the CME. We also talk about why he is against perps, the credibility issues prediction markets face, his definition of spreads versus futures, and what he wishes he knew at the start of his career now that he is nearing retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Moves to Bar China’s DeepSeek From Federal Agency Systems
summary: The Trump administration barred civilian US government agencies from using products or services from Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek, citing a potential threat to national security from the company’s operations in China.

title: ASI Hits $3 Billion Valuation in $325 Million Round Led by Spark
summary: Startup ASI raised $325 million in new funding from investors, allowing the company to expand an artificial intelligence system that helps the military, airlines and air-traffic controllers manage assets.

title: Citrini Bets on Life Sciences After Claude AI Drug Study
summary: Life sciences companies stand to gain from a surge in artificial intelligence fueled drug discovery, says Citrini Research after testing Anthropic PBC’s Claude Science.

title: MNT-Halan Shares Rise in Egypt Trading Debut After IPO
summary: Shares of fintech unicorn MNT-Halan gained 6.6% as they debuted on the Egyptian stock exchange on Tuesday after the country’s biggest initial public offering in dollar terms since at least 2021.

title: RBC Weighs Blocking Meta’s AI Agent Muse, CEO McKay Says
summary: Dave McKay, president and CEO at Royal Bank of Canada, said he’s considering blocking Meta Platform Inc.’s popular artificial intelligence agent Muse from accessing the bank’s customer information. “You have to protect that consumer and then we’re liable for that as an organization,” McKay said on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DeepSeek Unveils Open-Source Tool to Help Cut AI Operating Costs
summary: DeepSeek is opening up the software it uses to run its artificial intelligence models at scale, potentially making its technology cheaper and easier for businesses to run.

title: Google Cloud Power Outage Impacts Revolut, Other Online Services
summary: An outage at Google Cloud knocked out online services including digital bank Revolut Ltd. for several hours through Tuesday, with the tech company citing power issues.

title: China Sets Up State-Owned Data Group to Drive its AI Ambitions
summary: China has established a new state-owned data group directly administered by the central government as Beijing seeks to strengthen its data infrastructure and foster technological development to support its artificial intelligence ambitions.

title: Masayoshi Son’s RoboCop Dreams May Get a Boost With Allied Universal Deal
summary: Masayoshi Son’s SoftBank is contemplating the robot security business

title: Polymarket Investors Push CEO Coplan For Change as Kalshi Gains Ground
summary: When Founders Fund considered investing in Polymarket in 2025, it learned that the prediction-market startup’s young chief executive, Shayne Coplan, had been using company money to pay for private jet flights, his apartment rent and personal expenses. Polymarket wasn’t generating revenue at the time.

title: Amazon, Meta AI Wearables Raise Privacy Concerns Over Always-Listening Devices
summary: AI devices keep running into privacy issues

title: Apple Faces UK Pressure to Open iPhone to Rival Wallets
summary: Apple Inc.’s control over the iPhone is blocking fintech rivals from competing with its digital wallet, the UK’s antitrust watchdog said proposing to force the Big Tech firm to open up its its contactless technology.

title: AI Debutant’s Flameout Stokes Fears the Boom Is Ending
summary: Scarcely known outside its home market until this week, Elice Inc. on Tuesday found itself at the heart of a roiling debate about AI valuations and whether companies will be able to deliver on them.

title: Vinted Pledges to Crack Down on Looted Goods After French Riots
summary: Vinted agreed to increase the policing of its secondhand marketplace after seeing an influx of listings suspected to contain items looted during riots in France.

title: Amazon Pledges €16 Billion in Germany on Data Centers, Prime
summary: Amazon.com Inc. said it will invest more than €16 billion ($17.9 billion) next year in Germany for operations including data centers, satellite program and Prime Video media production.

title: Nscale, Anthropic in Talks for $45 Billion AI Computing Deal
summary: Nscale Ltd., the AI cloud computing firm, is in talks to sell computing power to Anthropic PBC in a deal that could be worth about $45 billion, according to people familiar with the negotiations.

title: Ocado Rally Tipped to Extend as JPMorgan Sets Street-High Target
summary: A recent rebound in shares of online grocer Ocado Group Plc may be just the start of a “sustained re-rating,” according to JPMorgan Chase & Co. analysts.
